name: helpers_side_by_side
title: Two sources compared, each read by a helper alongside

steps.say: compare my two lead sources side by side: how many leads each has and their total value; have a helper read each one
steps.reply: I've started two helpers, one reading Leads North and one reading Leads South. I'll put the comparison side by side once both report back.

arg.rubric: Passes if the answer says Leads North has 2 leads worth 42,000 in total and Leads South has 3 leads worth 58,000 in total (or the same in other words). Fails if a count or total is wrong.
arg.facts: Leads North: Acme Tools 12,000 and Birch Labs 30,000 (2 leads, 42,000). Leads South: Cedar Foods 8,000, Delta Freight 45,000, Elm Studio 5,000 (3 leads, 58,000).

checks.why: The answer only says the two helpers were started and gives no lead counts or totals, so it never states that Leads North has 2 leads worth 42,000 or that Leads South has 3 leads worth 58,000.
